Delivery meters

Deliveries split the receipts' gas equally; each one's dp is solved from that flow.

Which errors are shared

0 is independent at every meter; 1 is one common error. The discharge coefficient's starts at 0, the first row of the page's table; no open source says which value is right.

Monte Carlo

Measured receipts minus measured deliveries, as a share of true throughput, over one year of calibration intervals. The true gas balances exactly; every bit of imbalance here is measurement. Propagated by Monte Carlo after JCGM 101:2008, run until its 7.9.4 stopping rule is met.
